amendment: Before any fitting: permit explicit, evidence-backed false-positive review of average-hash candidate pairs; retain low-information videos in the raw-asset metadata diagnostic. Sample selection, features, classifier and metrics are unchanged.
hypothesis: Observed metadata may carry source-label shortcuts even after original-video-prefix grouping.
grouping: One real clip per inferred original-video prefix; fake groups provisional by source path; SHA256 cross-role duplicate check.
failure_policy: No silent dropping or replacement; report error and refuse fitting if any sampled file cannot be hashed/probed.
duplicate_review: Every cross-role near-duplicate candidate requires not_duplicate verdict with matching video SHA256 and evidence paths; confirmed duplicates block fitting. Quality failures are logged, not silently replaced.
limitations: Historical data already examined; all roles are development only, not confirmatory test.
Prefix grouping does not prove content or prompt independence.
Metadata classifier diagnoses shortcuts; it is not a video forgery detector.
No model selection using audit results; all listed feature sets will be reported.
